_comment: Review rules as code. Deterministic ones (regex) always run. LLM rules must have pass and fail criteria, otherwise the model guesses.

rules.message: Looks like a secret pasted into the code.
An empty catch swallows the error.
A TODO in new code: open an issue or do it now.
The tuning table is frozen (ADR-011): a constant changes in a design decision, not in a work order.

rules.rule: A test checks the requirement; it does not restate the implementation.
rules.pass: The test builds a world from a map, plays frames through tick() and compares the result with a value worked out by hand or with a property (he moved right, he is on the ground, two replays are equal). Using a tuning constant by name (CREATURE_STARTLE_TICKS, RUN_SPEED) is expected: constants.ts is the frozen spec, and the tests assert against its names, never literals.
rules.fail: The test computes the expected value with the same formula as the production code, so it passes even for a wrong formula.

rules.rule: Nothing from outside the game reaches it unchecked.
rules.pass: Text from the state or the manifest that goes into a URL, an issue body or the DOM is encoded (encodeURIComponent, textContent).
rules.fail: A URL or HTML is built by concatenating text the player or the manifest controls.
